purpose: Map imported Sigma history into the active Invariant goal. This is a research queue, not a list of surviving theories or an exhaustive search.
history_class: Previously exposed, heterogeneous development and diagnostic summaries; historical holdout labels do not confer new independence.

directions.name: Ordered-motion and phase coherence
directions.next_discriminating_work: Define one independently measured invariant coherence field; derive reciprocal matter coupling and its dynamics. Audit the exact input implementation for response reuse and object-dependent phase factors before any prediction claim.
directions.warning: The old document uses observed velocity structure in one phase proxy and fitted phase/size prescriptions. This does not establish that every later implementation uses the same inputs.

directions.next_discriminating_work: Require an action-derived field equation and one operational C definition. Historical derived-lensing amplitude scores cannot replace raw image roots, multiplicity, parity and positions.
directions.warning: The handoff's empirical bridge constants are fitted historical values, not constants derived from first principles.

directions.name: Measured density and kinematic coherence interpolation
directions.next_discriminating_work: Avoid another sweep of the same local logistic law. A new nonspherical action or independently measurable source would be a materially different hypothesis.
directions.warning: A failure of this mapping does not reject every refracted-gravity field equation.

directions.name: Coherent monopole about the baryonic center
directions.next_discriminating_work: Any successor must derive source-reaction terms from an action and test cluster separation, total force and torque before observations. Do not merely subtract the mean acceleration after solving.
directions.warning: This audit covers the base. The P0697 routed addition and later source blends are different operators; their historical empirical failures are recorded separately.

directions.name: Local vector coherence
directions.formula: C=|sum_j g_Nj|/sum_j|g_Nj|; S_base=C*S_coh+(1-C)*S_local, with the registered boundary and routing term
directions.next_discriminating_work: A new continuum action must define the scalar denominator independent of arbitrary source partition, carry reaction forces, and explain why cancellations encode the relevant physics.
directions.warning: The historical code uses source-cell convolution, not an arbitrary catalogue sum. Its disk cancellations selected the wrong endpoint; do not repair this with an object label.

directions.name: Barycentric radial alignment
directions.formula: A_r=max(0,-g_N dot rhat)/|g_N|; S_base=A_r*S_coh+(1-A_r)*S_local, with the registered boundary and routing term
directions.next_discriminating_work: Use a physically distinct directional source if developing a new law. Net-field angle to one global center did not distinguish multi-center structure in the historical scenes.
directions.warning: Both development systems are spent. No further formula selection on their residuals is proposed here.

directions.next_discriminating_work: Enumerate a finite, physically motivated action grammar; derive equations, conserved stresses, source-partition invariance, boundary conditions and one matter/photon metric before scoring.
directions.warning: The historical inference that raw lens topology needs richer spatial response is a hypothesis generator, not a theorem that all scalar theories fail.

directions.warning: The Aug 6 handoff identifies a forward-model defect across 494 regions and 5082 cells. It does not report a failed I4/I5 gravity test. No source spectra or reserved outcomes were opened by this import.

directions.name: Current bounded multi-field action continuation
directions.next_discriminating_work: Retain all quality-limited galaxy comparisons. Nine p=2, lambda=10 cards need source-map and field refinement; none is scored. The exact spherical auxiliary correction remains zero. Full source-response audit, independent replication, and nonspherical cluster dynamics and lensing remain required.
directions.warning: An exactly spherical collinear solution has zero auxiliary correction. It cannot repair the current spherical cluster-pressure discrepancy simply by changing auxiliary coupling.

directions.name: Action-derived length-sensitive response
directions.next_discriminating_work: Refine multipole truncation and any other failures identified in the complete direct-difference grid table. Preserve coarser failures and all cards, distances and thicknesses. Direct subtraction noise is reduced but no small physical effect is admitted. Evaluate the extended cards on the galaxy source; retain the cluster source-geometry hold and historical force failures without physical rankings. Physical source/geometry propagation and all cross-regime light, stability, Solar System and independent-validation requirements remain open.
directions.warning: All 4715 original locations per thickness and eight separate source refinements pass. The new active correction passes independent fine-step derivative checks with maximum third-tensor discrepancies 3.346782e-7 nominal and 4.765752e-7 half-height, below the unchanged 1e-4 target. This verifier differentiates the correction, normalized by the full field; inherited Hankel and exterior checks are separate. These are finite sampled numerical results, not a uniform continuum bound, production interpolation, completed action solve or new observational validation. The Gauss-weight unit failure and first precise verifier indexing failure are retained.

directions.name: Source gravity over overlapping physical ranges
directions.formula: g=GM/r^2 [1+integral B(r/lambda) d alpha(lambda)], B(u)=1-(1+u)exp(-u). Illustrative d alpha=d lambda/L gives a 1/r extra-force regime between finite cutoffs.
directions.next_discriminating_work: Derive a nonlinear continuum range spectrum or source-dependent emergent scale from a universally coupled action, retaining mass-source partition invariance and source reaction. The linear comparator has v_flat proportional to sqrt(M) in its compact-source flat regime; quarter-power behavior requires an emergent L proportional to sqrt(M). Test complete extended sources and Sun/planets inside the external Galactic field. Clusters, light, stability and independent prediction remain required.
directions.warning: This is not a rejection of arbitrary multiscale gravity. The finite ladder is a known-family realization; Item19 documents the subtracted-Yukawa equivalence and prior scoped tests. The proposed spectrum is an illustrative choice, not a first-principles derivation. A per-piece sqrt(m) repair fails source splitting by sqrt(2).

directions.name: Elastic or nonlinear constitutive gravity response
directions.formula: A literal added Hooke pull g_extra proportional to r gives v proportional to r when dominant. A nonlinear field law div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0)grad Phi]=4pi G rho with mu approximately |grad Phi|/a0 gives the known spherical sqrt(GMa0)/r response.
directions.next_discriminating_work: Specify real field degrees of freedom, stored energy, constitutive law and universal coupling; derive the source-dependent collective response rather than merely naming a fitted force elastic. Distinguish a new mechanism from known MOND-like equations and the historical Item38 formula. Require a reason for different cluster response while preserving the local limit and full matter/light dynamics.
directions.warning: This analytic slope result does not reject nonlinear elasticity or finite-range springs. The earlier Item38 elastic-transition trial had a development improvement and failed unchanged transfers and was not promoted. No new astronomical scores were produced here.

user_mechanism_questions.environment_dependent_response: Open possibility; distinguish potential depth, acceleration and tides. Require universal coupling, conservation, local-limit and equivalence-principle tests, plus the same constants across regimes.
user_mechanism_questions.matter_current_or_vortex_response: Open possibility, not selected or rejected by these source audits. Requires a defined current field and its dynamics, source/reaction conservation, nonrotating and counterrotating controls, the local limit and photon predictions.
